info.name: Scalable E-Commerce API
info.description:
Backend for a scalable e-commerce platform built with Node.js, Express 5 and PostgreSQL.

Public endpoints need no login. Protected endpoints need an access token:
log in, then click **Authorize** and paste the `accessToken`.

item.name: Check that the API and database are running

request.description: Creates a user with the customer role and logs them in straight away. The email is trimmed and lowercased. Unknown fields (such as role) are ignored.

response.name: Account created; returns the user and both tokens
Invalid input

item.name: Log in with email and password

request.description: Returns a 15-minute access token and a 7-day single-use refresh token. A wrong password and an unknown email give the same 401 response.

response.name: Invalid input

item.name: Swap a refresh token for new tokens

request.description: Each refresh token works only once (rotation). Reusing an old token is treated as theft, and every session for that user is revoked.

response.name: New access token and new refresh token
Invalid input
The refresh token is invalid, expired, or was already used

request.description: Revokes the given refresh token. Always returns 204, even for unknown tokens. The access token keeps working until it expires (up to 15 minutes).
